title: The Giant
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about a boss that is really several monsters. A monster is one block, so a giant is four standing together: Rocky, made of stone, fills a narrow way with the exit door behind him, and each part pops on its own. A star flies level with Rima's hand, so the head needs a step to stand on. In level 2 a tin robot takes two hits a part: after the first it blinks red for a moment and a star goes right through, so you wait. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the parts.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has a pocketful of gold stars and two short levels to cross. Rocky, big, grumpy and made of stone, fills a narrow way to the door, but a monster is only one block, so he is really four, and each pops on its own. Then a tin robot blinks red when it is hit, and a star goes right through it. Read the signs, press Enter, wait your turn, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at the parts.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A giant is four monsters standing together
A hit part blinks red, and stars go through it
Made to be copied and taken apart
